zh.description:
### 大肥鱼（Cortico 扩展）

和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话，让大肥鱼替你干活、写代码；它也能朗读 DSH 的回复，把你在桌面说的话交给 DSH。

**能做什么**
- 对话桥接：在 DSH 的会话之间传话，支持会话清单、指名投递、固定与解除固定
- 通知分级：每轮结果合并成一条，批准 / 提问 / 出错立即提醒
- 语音朗读：内置 Edge TTS，可选自建 HTTP 语音引擎与分句流水线（默认关，需在设置里打开）
- 代点选项：可选让大肥鱼替你点 DSH 的批准与选项（默认关）
- 自动交接：上下文快满时自动新建会话并交接

**安装**
- 在 Cortico 里安装本扩展（cortico-world-fatfish）
- 桥接需要 DSH 侧插件 coopanion-connector-dsh（GitHub 分发，未上 npm），装好后两侧自动发现
- 两个转发开关（relayPerson / relayPet）默认关闭，按需在设置里打开
- 版本配对与逐版改动见仓库 README / CHANGELOG

仓库：https://github.com/blacksunshy/coopanion-fatfish
当前版本 v0.6.30

en.description:
### Fatfish (Cortico extension)

Talk to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and let the pet do the work — write code, run tools, read its replies aloud, and carry what you say on the desktop into DSH.

**What it does**
- Bridge: trades lines with DSH conversations, with a session list, named delivery, pin and unpin
- Notice levels: one notice per finished turn; approvals, questions and errors come through at once
- Voice: built-in Edge TTS, or your own HTTP speech engine with a sentence pipeline (off by default)
- Click for you: optionally let the pet answer DSH's approvals and questions (off by default)
- Handover: opens a fresh conversation when the context is nearly full

**Install**
- Install this extension (cortico-world-fatfish) from Cortico
- The bridge needs the DSH-side plugin coopanion-connector-dsh (GitHub only, not on npm); the two find each other once both are installed
- relayPerson / relayPet are off by default; turn them on in the settings if you want them
- See the repo README / CHANGELOG for version pairing and per-release notes

Repo: https://github.com/blacksunshy/coopanion-fatfish
Current version v0.6.30
